defmodule AuthService.TokenVerifier do
  @moduledoc """
  JWT-like token verification service with HMAC-SHA256.
  Supports compact token format for bandwidth-constrained environments.
  """

  @secret Application.compile_env(:auth_service, :hmac_secret, :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32))
  @max_clock_skew 30
  @algorithm :sha256

  defstruct [:header, :payload, :signature]

  def verify_token(token_string) when is_binary(token_string) do
    with {:ok, parts} <- split_token(token_string),
         {:ok, header} <- decode_header(parts.header_b64),
         {:ok, payload} <- decode_payload(parts.payload_b64),
         :ok <- verify_algorithm(header),
         :ok <- verify_timestamps(payload),
         :ok <- verify_signature(parts) do
      {:ok, payload}
    end
  end

  defp split_token(token) do
    case String.split(token, ".") do
      [header_b64, payload_b64, sig_b64] ->
        {:ok, %{header_b64: header_b64, payload_b64: payload_b64, sig_b64: sig_b64}}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_token}
    end
  end

  defp decode_header(header_b64) do
    with {:ok, json} <- Base.url_decode64(header_b64, padding: false),
         {:ok, header} <- Jason.decode(json) do
      {:ok, header}
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_header}
    end
  end

  defp decode_payload(payload_b64) do
    with {:ok, json} <- Base.url_decode64(payload_b64, padding: false),
         {:ok, payload} <- Jason.decode(json) do
      {:ok, payload}
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_payload}
    end
  end

  defp verify_algorithm(%{"alg" => "HS256"}), do: :ok
  defp verify_algorithm(_), do: {:error, :unsupported_algorithm}

  defp verify_timestamps(%{"exp" => exp, "iat" => iat, "nbf" => nbf}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    cond do
      now > exp + @max_clock_skew -> {:error, :token_expired}
      now < nbf - @max_clock_skew -> {:error, :token_not_yet_valid}
      iat > now + @max_clock_skew -> {:error, :invalid_issued_at}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end
  defp verify_timestamps(%{"exp" => exp}) do
    now = System.system_time(:second)
    if now > exp + @max_clock_skew, do: {:error, :token_expired}, else: :ok
  end
  defp verify_timestamps(_), do: {:error, :missing_timestamps}

  defp verify_signature(%{header_b64: h, payload_b64: p, sig_b64: sig_b64}) do
    signing_input = h <> "." <> p
    computed_mac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, @algorithm, @secret, signing_input)

    with {:ok, provided_sig} <- Base.url_decode64(sig_b64, padding: false) do
      # Support variable-length signatures for compact token format
      # Verify provided signature matches the prefix of computed MAC
      sig_length = byte_size(provided_sig)
      if sig_length >= 8 and sig_length <= byte_size(computed_mac) do
        computed_prefix = binary_part(computed_mac, 0, sig_length)
        secure_compare(computed_prefix, provided_sig)
      else
        {:error, :invalid_signature_length}
      end
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_signature_encoding}
    end
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    result = :crypto.exor(a, b)
    if result == <<0::size(byte_size(a) * 8)>> do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :signature_mismatch}
    end
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: {:error, :signature_mismatch}
end

defmodule AuthService.SessionManager do
  @moduledoc "Manages authenticated sessions after token verification."
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
  end

  def authenticate(server, token_string) do
    GenServer.call(server, {:authenticate, token_string})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:authenticate, token_string}, _from, state) do
    case AuthService.TokenVerifier.verify_token(token_string) do
      {:ok, payload} ->
        session_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
        new_state = Map.put(state, session_id, %{
          user_id: payload["sub"],
          authenticated_at: System.system_time(:second),
          claims: payload
        })
        {:reply, {:ok, session_id, payload}, new_state}
      error ->
        {:reply, error, state}
    end
  end
end
